scripts.build: npm run build -w @lw/shared && npm run build -w @lw/server && npm run build -w @lw/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p shared && tsc --noEmit -p shared/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p client && tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p scripts
